description: Shiori at the culture festival: all of FU_S6.BIN, FU_S6B.BIN, FU_S6I.BIN, FU_S6O.BIN, FU_S6S.BIN, FU_S6W.BIN (2197 strings; base 0x801E8000). Verified in DuckStation on forced festival days (tools/emu/force_festival.py, hidden emulator; docs/testing.md 'The culture festival'): her answer as a Literature Club member (S6I); her poetry exhibit when the player goes alone (S6O); her visit to the player's exhibit for all six exhibiting clubs (S6, S6B), with the Science explosion, the Art portrait and the PC fortune. Not seen: S6S (her LBA-table entry 11) and the tour (S6W). Layout and flow in game-internals 6ab. The stage shows (Drama play, Band concert, Literature speech contest) are BUNKA_SD.EXN, still Japanese. Natural triggers, other years and moods checked only statically.
